text:
maya: Hey folks — flying into Chicago Tues for the conf. Any West Loop lunch recs within walking distance of McCormick Place? Looking for something not too slow (12:30ish) — pizza vs sandwiches vs quick salads? Thx!

jonathan: Au Cheval is legendary but expect a long wait. If you need fast+solid, try The Loyalist (next door) — great burger and usually quicker.

samir: For deep dish, Pequod's is classic but 20min walk. Italian beef? Al's is the tourist fave. For fast healthy, Summer House or Little Goat.

rachel: Little Goat is fun — brunch vibes. For tacos, check Tavernita. If you want a tiny deli vibe, Kasama-ish places nearby are good.

maya: Awesome recs. I'm leaning Loyalist since it's close and fast. Anyone actually local who knows exact walking times from the center?

jonathan: From McCormick it's like a 10–12 min walk to Loyalist depending on crosswalks. Parson's is a bit farther but still doable.

samir: If folks want sit-down and time to chat, Parson's has big tables. For speed, Loyalist. For a Chicago staple, Pequod's deep dish adds 20–30 mins.

rachel: Quick poll then — vote with emoji: :hamburger: Loyalist (quick), :pizza: Pequod's (deep dish), :taco: Parson's (sit but casual), :green_salad: Summer House (healthy)

jonathan: :hamburger:

samir: :hamburger: (unless deep dish cravings hit me)

maya: :hamburger: Locking in Loyalist 12:30 Tue then. Thanks y'all!

ops-bot: calendar: Event created — "West Loop Lunch — Maya + team" Tuesday 12:30–13:30 @ The Loyalist. RSVP added for maya, jonathan, samir, rachel.

maya: Added quick addresses in case you want to pin: ```The Loyalist — 630 W Lake St, Chicago, IL
Pequod's — 2207 N Clybourn Ave, Chicago, IL
Al's Italian Beef — 169 E Ontario St, Chicago, IL```

jonathan: Map: https://goo.gl/maps/2example (short link) See you Tue! :wave:

rachel: If anyone's coming earlier and wants coffee, hit me up — I'll swing by the lobby at 11:45.

maya: Perfect — appreciate the recs and the company. See you all!
